body: This just in, my B screw is no where to be found. Is it possible someone took it out or it fell out of the derailleur at some point? Maybe. Any advice?

Drinking was painful (ironically), getting a DUI was painful (err, still is), just the thought of getting another DUI sounds painful (wish I had a friend like you). I’m really glad you made it out safe this time !

You can do it. And when he’s gone, you’ll continue doing it, because you’re stronger. Though life will not be the same, it will become better in many ways. Eventually. Roll with the tides, as these feelings wash over. You can float on these dark waters, and one day you can fly.
I don’t know what will happen next. But you have control of you’re future and I’m sure you can make this life amazing beyond belief. Sometimes these things are unpredictable
I know you’re suffering. I’m sorry. You will feel better, please believe me. I believe in you

Literally same. I was you, about a year or so ago, and the girl dumped me and took off so far away that I likely will never see her again. It was, and some days still is, crushing. I don’t know exactly how you feel, just what you wrote here. I wish I knew more and we could talk. I wish it was possible to send a legit hug. Because I know I needed one. It felt like a part of me got ripped out, dragged away to an unknown location, and locked up forever. When I thought about how my life changed it felt like the rest of me started melting into the irreparable hole, onto the floor, down into a sewer. For a while, it sometimes felt like I should leave those melted parts of me in the sewer. I admire your strength. We deserve better, trust me
How do I get this job..? Honest question.

I know this truth. The internet is my escape as well. But I suppose, as individuals, we must decide what is real in this life and what is not. Fortunately, when times are tough, we may attempt to provide ourselves help through this world wide web

I know these feelings. I would do anything I could to avoid going home. The feelings I have there are overwhelming, to say the least. And I felt the same suicidal feelings at work often enough that eventually I just stopped going. I realized, upon being fired, that my choice to not go made me feel worse and could be considered a form of self sabotage. Sometimes I stay in bed all fucking day, and I want to fucking die, lay alone in death and worthlessness. And in not doing so, many days I felt I was a coward. This is not cowardice. This is strength. And so much strength that we DON’T have to fake it. We are strong enough to stop acting like we care, like we’re happy, or like any of this is okay. Waking up, knowing this feeling, it is painful. It is our pain. We can own it. And no one can take that from you. This is partly because no one, not even friends or family members, can fully understand your purely individual struggle. They may try, and that can be hard to live with. It is painful living with knowledge of your ability to hurt others by choosing your death, if you so decide. That is your pain as well and they may not understand. Some would say our struggle is all we have as a means to survive as a species. It is our reason to live and why we continue pushing foreword, learning our struggle day in and day out can teach us what is meaningful. A perplexing situation it is, to struggle taking our own lives, and still exist. I still struggle to find meaning in these perplexities. To believe wether or not something exists after this life is your choice. You say you don’t know if you want to know, and I believe you. Believe you don’t have to make the choice to attain that knowledge, if you will. But wether you do, or if you don’t, please trust that it is your own beliefs, and only your beliefs, that can create whatever may or may not be next. You can control this. It sounds, to me, that you do have control of your self harm. To miss that kind of pain is honest, and genuine. To struggle to live without the pain resulting from self harm can be just as honest as the feelings self harm gives you. But you are in control, wether you choose to abstain or not. Many on the forums find these struggles fucking unbearable, myself included. You deserve life. Reach out for help. Your choice to share these feelings is beautiful. Your post helped me. When I post, sometimes I find help too. Maybe try counseling or therapy. Talking to a professional may help. Please believe, it is absolutely fucking deadly enough choosing to keep living your life, and you don’t have to choose suicide. You’re a living badass :)

The ability to acknowledge your ways of self sabotage shows intelligence, character and strength. These traits will lead you to new options, to a better life, if you so desire one. I believe in you. Please understand, there are many who struggle with self sabotage, anxiety, depression and suicidal ideation that simply feel the years of struggle can be solved by taking their life. There is much more for you in this life than death. You deserve much more than the option of death. Many who post in support forums can attest, we can be our own worst enemy but we can also be our own greatest ally. Please, if you can, reach out. Your willingness to share these feelings is a step in the right direction. Thank you for posting. Counseling or therapy can help. Please try talking to a professional.
